description: Where one knowledge entry was used, newest first: when, from where (Gene, a Builder, the person's assistant, the Knowledge page), what for (a search, a read) and which version, from the last 90 days, with the entry's lasting use count. Reading this is not a use.

before.description: Only uses before this one: the nextBefore of the previous page. Leave it out for the first page.

knowledge_id.description: The entry (list_knowledge and search_knowledge give ids).

project_id.description: The project the entry is in. May be left out: the entry's id finds its own project or the workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: list_knowledge_uses
title: Where a knowledge entry was used
